## Open issues

- [#220](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/220) — A blocking evaluator has no durable bounded rework policy, so automatic quality loops become human gates or shell control flow
- [#219](https://github.com/jamchen/aldus/issues/219) — A DAG has no round, no convergence verdict, no bound and no stop reason, so the one control flow a production depends on lives in an operator's bash loop
